name: Meander Timeline
description: Events along a river that winds down the page in slow bends and fills with water as you scroll, with each event on alternate banks joined by a small tributary and a leaf drifting at the reading position.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: ReactNode; date: ReactNode; content?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The events, in order down the river. Each becomes a small card on alternate banks, or a single column on screens narrower than 640px.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and takes the width of its parent. Other div props are passed through.
